needs.premise: One selected foreign wrapper, one task/owner and one round; qualified semantic delay, isolation, roots, physical effects and safe error recovery are premises; no full-GC or real callback/fairness model

25 conditional declarations: complete seal gates, source/service credit Step/Trace, isolated outcome independence, disposition distinct from error, callback cycle and stale seal rejection; no all-action QNT/C simulation

Every admitted strong/weak/private/cleanup duty closes or has qualified deferred handoff; capacity success or safe-error outcome, context preparation, result delivery, binding, writer closure and current generation precede active permit; domain-wide finalizer inventory required

Reserve before destructive wrapper retirement; canonical task owns payload/dependencies/credits and accepted decision before source drops custody; queue notification or transport loss is not acceptance/completion

Foreign payload is opaque to scan; deferred managed dependencies must already be traced and rooted or trigger pre-seal rescan; native/RC/code/library storage survives actual cleanup_rc and old-reader drain

Only qualified native-only execution may overlap GC; owner/managed callback waits until active permit and rooted activation, while cleanup never waits for that callback; explicit WaitContext replaces PSTATE scratch

GC, explicit foreign-release!, constructor rollback and teardown have different invocation/error/timing contracts; at-most-once invocation preserved and delay permission is explicit, not inferred from unreachable wrapper

Unknown handoff/root/writer/capacity/binding/gate states refuse resume; isolated native result unknown may retain resources while GC resumes; typed effect/disposition forbids replay or refund inferred from scalar error
Release/acquire handoff/terminal/seal publication, code/root/native pin drain, generation wrap and external effect/stop boundary require actual C/platform refinement; no arbitrary owner-death repair
Strong termination includes pending/owned/private/ready/quarantined root and descendant obligations, separate weak generation and cleanup; empty queues or idle count alone not proof
RootAck never implies ResumeSeal; weak continuation movement, cleanup, capacity/fudge/context preparation and synchronized result delivery complete before active permit and reload

Workers/coordinator never wait for the same return permit, metadata gate or owner-affine destructor needed by round completion; complete wait graph, finite producers, worker capacity and fairness remain source/progress duties

Task publication, claim/attempt fencing, stable Ready result, stop/checkpoint transfer and whole-round seal use proved C happens-before and lifetime ordering; no volatile-only, timeout or machine-wrap qualification

Point-specific live roots include exported GVM registers, saved values, type caches, frame/denv roots, host locals and all RC domains; address/location coverage, lifetime and writable relocation slots required; no arbitrary C-stack inference

Reentry request closes new round admission, honors already-enlisted pending/in-flight root scans, validates current epoch/roots/binding and grants active participation before reload; no second scan may race protected reload; metadata pins retire after use

Acquire callback permission before RC payload/marker access, root proc before allocation, retain suspended parent activation roots, publish fresh parent view on callback exit; unknown writers, closure identity or nonlocal exit reject transfer

Publish qualified native participation and frozen context roots before acceptance; no-escape raw-enter through ready publication: cancellation/handler policy established before acceptance; no Scheme checkpoint, callback, logging, foreign unwind or local-only result ownership; OS preemption remains allowed

Before restoring masks/cancellation or propagating Scheme errors: release gate, publish outcome, retain result/root in stable service and restore VM/processor binding; stopped owner recovery needs independent scan/stop evidence

Initial relation, every real source action/stutter, concrete observation reflection and progress; freeze/last-use/drain/issue permit/reclaim; unknown outcomes retain custody; reopened generation invalidates permit

sealCosts.removedWork: Move only qualified delayed release body off round-critical cleanup
sealCosts.bound: Serial conditional work: old=Tcore+sum(Fi), new=Tcore+sum(Hi)+ledger/rescan costs
sealCosts.addedCost: Reservation/handoff, root closure and new queue contention
sealCosts.condition: Saving only if Fi exceeds Hi plus added costs and delay semantics permit; no measured time or universal positive benefit

sealCosts.removedWork: Reuse shared descriptor/queue/attempt/result machinery across eligible leaves
sealCosts.bound: One reserve, acceptance, claim and terminal-publication transition per ordinary task; notifications/queries separate
sealCosts.addedCost: Stable metadata, source/service custody and bounded admission pools
sealCosts.condition: These are design operations, not four machine atomics or four syscall costs

sealCosts.removedWork: Preserve callback procedure/managed dependencies across delayed execution
sealCosts.bound: Additional root scanning O(Rdeps); newly discovered roots require closed rescan before seal
sealCosts.addedCost: Root-domain records, relocation-safe handles and retained dependency backing
sealCosts.condition: Opaque foreign payload cannot silently become scanned; no new unseen managed edge after closure

sealCosts.removedWork: GC can resume despite isolated native outcome uncertainty
sealCosts.bound: Zero additional invocation on outcome query; zero refund without known disposition
sealCosts.condition: Only effect-isolated admitted cohort; handoff/root/gate/capacity uncertainty still refuses resume

sealCosts.removedWork: Avoid replay/free based on scalar error
sealCosts.bound: At most one invocation per foreign release attempt; FailedFreed must not free again
sealCosts.addedCost: Typed effect progress and allocation-disposition ledger
sealCosts.condition: Current device_release can free on error; external close outcome and device-storage outcome differ

sealCosts.removedWork: Publish accepted callback task then let owner reacquire before executing it
sealCosts.bound: Cleanup waits handoff/root closure, not owner callback completion
sealCosts.condition: Unknown affinity/hidden callback or delayed-effect semantics rejects profile; no guaranteed callback latency

sealCosts.removedWork: Reserve delivery/root/native-dependency budget before released GC profile is admitted
sealCosts.bound: For M admitted possible jobs: O(M) task slots plus exact retained native/root backing budget
sealCosts.addedCost: Registration/reservation capacity can raise resident/peak memory
sealCosts.condition: Pool failure before destructive transfer retains source; never block GC waiting for owner that waits for seal

sealCosts.removedWork: Keep physical backing distinct from wrapper retirement and receipt ACK
sealCosts.addedCost: Deferred cleanup may postpone native/RC/library release beyond this GC
sealCosts.condition: Do not add independent maxima or refund on enqueue; no whole-round peak reduction proved

sealCosts.removedWork: Reuse Scheme semantic/FrameSpec output and C representation/conversion machinery
sealCosts.bound: Zero additional Zig runtime-work reduction established
sealCosts.addedCost: Both require effect/origin profiles, root transfer, stop/restore and ordering proofs
sealCosts.condition: Modernization gain is role/ownership/phase separation, not a language-provided GC or automatic finalization proof

nodes.labelText: Strong + weak frontier closed\nroot/view obligations retained
Origin + effect + delay admission\nreserve native/root/code/wait budget
Canonical accepted release task\nsource -> service custody
GC cleanup handback\nno wait for owner callback
Capacity outcome + context prepare\nresult / writer / binding checks
Owner callback / native executor\nqualified activation + WaitContext
Known effects + storage disposition\nseparate native backing release
Unknown GC-critical state\nretain custody; refuse resume
Isolated native result unknown\nretain backing; no replay

diagramEdges.labelText: native-only may run; managed waits seal

callers.actualChain: Manual requires at-most-once release invocation; explicit call returns/raises using release result
callers.hazard: Queue acceptance is not invocation/completion; error and timing cannot be redefined silently
callers.replacement: Origin-specific adapters; opt-in effect/delay profile and public observation contract

callers.actualChain: GC sweep and free_still_objs call release_foreign then free wrapper; cleanup_mem_pstate then frees RC chain
callers.hazard: Deferred native dependencies can outlive wrapper/PSTATE; task enqueue cannot authorize native free
callers.replacement: Detach only after stable accepted custody; drain or actually transfer RC/native/code ownership before teardown

callers.actualChain: POINTER_to_SCMOBJ stores release_fn and native pointer; release_foreign clears both then invokes arbitrary C function
callers.hazard: Cleared fields prevent retry; failure can follow destructive effects; source has no typed effect/affinity schema
callers.replacement: Preinstalled descriptor/attempt; no raw clear-to-publish gap or blind replay

callers.actualChain: Three constructor conversions directly invoke release_fn on conversion failure
callers.hazard: Ownership starts before a Scheme wrapper exists; new deferral can change return/error/cleanup ordering
callers.replacement: Keep caller synchronous semantics unless separately qualified; reserve/native payload custody before failure transfer

callers.actualChain: Raw fd and stream constructors register device_cleanup_from_ptr and synchronously cleanup on wrapping error
callers.hazard: Not every registration/rollback/leaf is qualified by one function pointer
callers.replacement: Shared DeviceReleaseSpec plus per-leaf/origin profile; no installed-target coverage claim

callers.actualChain: Unlink group; close read/write; EAGAIN waits in device_select; finally release
callers.hazard: Destructive partial failures, unbounded I/O wait and native users; no proof of owner callback in this helper alone
callers.replacement: Resumable direction/effect state and dedicated WaitContext; no group-unlink retry

callers.actualChain: select/poll uses stack-local state, PSTATE fdset and abort channel
callers.hazard: Independent executor cannot borrow a released or destroyed context scratch lifetime
callers.replacement: Owned wait buffers/capacity/wake endpoint; dependency pins and no managed collective in leaf wait

callers.actualChain: device_release invokes virtual release then frees self even on error; close stage can change before OS error
callers.hazard: Nonzero error does not imply native allocation alive or safe retry
callers.replacement: Typed effects and allocation disposition; FailedFreed differs from AlivePartial/Unknown

callers.actualChain: TLS wrappers free strings, SSL_CTX/SSL and RC; configured session-remove callbacks may run inside SSL_CTX_free
callers.hazard: Library call name is not a no-callback proof; local callback configuration/installed library unqualified
callers.replacement: Bind effect profile to code/library/config revision; retain library and native dependency pins

callers.actualChain: FOREIGN scan is opaque; teardown frees still/RC before OS cleanup
callers.hazard: Opaque payload is not a Scheme root descriptor; RC addref does not survive unconditional cleanup_rc
callers.replacement: Existing traced root-domain ownership or rescan; drain/physical transfer before RC, wait, callback code withdrawal

callers.actualChain: GC phases then resize/fudge/prepare, sync result delivery, CFUN register reload
callers.hazard: RootAck/queue empty do not establish fresh fp/hp/limits, correct result or protected reload
callers.replacement: Immutable WholeRoundResumeSeal plus current-generation active permit, safe error continuation and reload
